month_goals._note: Your monthly minimums. Valid days and hours decide who stays active; diamonds decide the bonus. The danger line is set to 30% (TikTok's real shut-down line is 13%) so you have room to react.

manager_rules._note: Per-manager active percentage. A creator counts as active when they hit the valid-days AND hours minimums. Creators who joined less than min_tenure_days ago are left out, and managers with fewer than min_creators are only shown, never flagged. Your own email goes in owner_emails so creators assigned to you are not judged. Add manager emails and names under names.

unlock._note: New members see a small part of the server until they reach this quota, then everything opens. The window is counted from TikTok's 'Days since joining' column. Valid days are the better of this month so far and last month. Past window_days without reaching it, you get a staff alert (nobody is removed automatically). Set enabled to false to open everything on approval.
